reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: PlayStation Store UAE and Saudi product pages and Xbox Store UAE and Saudi pages read 11 Nov 16:50Z, prices as shown (PS Store UAE 299.16 AED Standard, 373.96 AED Ultimate; PS Store Saudi 301.56 SAR Standard; Xbox USD$79.99+ Standard, USD$99.99+ Ultimate); editions from Take-Two's pre-order release (24 Jun 2026); pre-load from 10 Nov (Rockstar Newswire, 3 Nov 2026). RE-READ every price on the day before 20:00 Dubai (series rule 5)
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: our pre-load Reel of 9 Nov gave times, not prices
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: hook the Gulf prices; why now 2 days to launch; for players here what it costs in AED and SAR; payoff pre-load is open
reel_check.STORY TYPE out now / price: yes: platforms, AED price with the dirham sign, SAR as the store shows it, Xbox in USD as the store shows it, the date
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: «أسعار GTA VI في متاجر الخليج. نسختان للعبة هما القياسية و Ultimate. [السعر في الإطار]. التحميل المسبق متاح منذ 10 نوفمبر.» No line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: تصدر في 19 نوفمبر on the frame
reel_check.STORY: names: yes: edition names as the publisher writes them (Ultimate), و spaced
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: Rockstar's cover art video music stem from 7.5 s (music_only); no speech in it
reel_check.SOUND: our effects only on our graphics: yes: the frame and chip blips only
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: Rockstar's Pre-Load Now video and Extended Look (the cover art video gives the music only); prices in the WHERE AND HOW MUCH frame and the strip, not a numbers card
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same picture as the las: yes: picture: the yacht (Pre-Load Now 11.3); not in the last five
reel_check.PICTURE: credit on every clip: yes: shots 0 to 3 and 5 to 6; shot 4 carries the price frame over Rockstar footage, and the design pass refuses a credit under the frame
